newsitem.title: THAILAND: Foreign funds from stock sales still in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Foreign funds from stock sales still in Thailand.

text.p: The head of Thailand's Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) said on Thursday the proceeds of recent heavy selling of Thai shares by foreigners is still in the local monetary system.

"We are checking with the central bank. The money from selling of the stocks has not yet been exchanged for the dollar and brought out. The funds are still in the money market and we are waiting for a clearer (picture)," the SEC secretary-general Pakorn Malakul Na Ayudhya told reporters.

Pakorn was speaking after meeting with representatives of seven local brokerages about the situation in the Thai stock market which has plunged to three-year-lows after heavy foreign selling this week of mainly bank stocks.
He said net foreign selling during October 1 to 9 was about eight billion baht ($1.6 billion).
Most of foreign selling in the stock market came from foreign funds rather than individual foreign investors, Pakorn said.
